animejs.name: Anime.js Animation Engine

rendering_constraints.notes: Anime.js lacks first-class integration with HyperFrames window.__timelines registration and would conflict with the established GSAP pipeline.

animejs.justification: BLOCKED: Redundant dependency. The repository standardized on GSAP 3 which provides proven, deterministic timeline management for HyperFrames headless capture. Introducing Anime.js creates cognitive overhead, dual timeline conflicts, and violates the repository's dependency minimization policy.

canvas2d-native.name: HTML5 Canvas 2D Rendering Context

licensing.notes: Native web standard supported natively across all modern browser engines.

rendering_constraints.notes: Canvas drawing routines must bind to timeline progress callbacks and use seeded PRNG (mulberry32) rather than unseeded Math.random.

canvas2d-native.justification: Approved core technology. Used when procedural particle simulations, field lines, or function plots exceed SVG DOM performance ceilings (>1000 nodes).

gsap.name: GreenSock Animation Platform (GSAP 3)

licensing.notes: Verified for motion graphic video renders and digital media explainer productions. Standard license covers commercial usage unless end users are charged directly for software bundling GSAP.

rendering_constraints.notes: Must instantiate timeline paused: true and mount to window.__timelines['root']. HyperFrames steps time deterministically.

gsap.justification: Approved core dependency. GSAP 3 is the foundational animation timeline engine for this repository. It guarantees frame-accurate deterministic stepping and integrates directly with HyperFrames capture without DOM thrashing.

html5-video.name: HTML5 Video Media Element

licensing.notes: Native HTML media element supported natively in Chromium.

rendering_constraints.notes: Video assets must be pre-normalized via scripts/ingest-asset.sh to 1280x720 @ 30fps silent H.264. Must specify muted and loop attributes.

html5-video.justification: Approved core technology. Used for hybrid cinematic layering (Veo/3D background underlays) placed beneath vector SVG stages.

svg-native.name: Native Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG 1.1 / 2.0)

licensing.notes: Open web standard implemented natively inside Chromium/Blink engine.

rendering_constraints.notes: Vector elements rasterize on GPU via ANGLE Metal. Highly performant when DOM node count remains under 500.

svg-native.justification: Approved core technology. Standard 2D vector format ensuring crisp, non-blurry line work, typography, and mathematical diagrams across 720p and 1080p outputs.

threejs.name: Three.js 3D WebGL Library

licensing.notes: Standard MIT license allows commercial use and modification.

rendering_constraints.notes: Headless Chromium WebGL context creation with ANGLE Metal on 8GB Apple Silicon risks exceeding memory budgets (>2GB) and frame-capture synchronization is unverified without custom RAF interception.

threejs.justification: PROPOSED ONLY: Candidate for true 3D spatial models. NOT currently approved for production because WebGL context management on 8GB Unified RAM exceeds the 1.5 GB memory budget and lacks verified HyperFrames timeline synchronization hooks.
